name: gizza-ai/rsa-sign
summary: Sign a message with an RSA private key.

tool.description: Sign a message with an RSA private key and return a base64-encoded signature. scheme=pkcs1v15 (default, deterministic RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5) or pss (randomized RSASSA-PSS); hash=sha256 (default), sha384, or sha512. The private key is PEM-encoded (PKCS#8 or PKCS#1). The signature verifies with the matching public key. Runs locally — the private key and message never leave the device.

private_key.description: Your RSA private key, PEM-encoded (PKCS#8 '-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----' or PKCS#1 '-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----').

scheme.description: Signature scheme: pkcs1v15 (default, deterministic) or pss (randomized).

hash.description: Digest algorithm to hash the message with before signing (default sha256).
